module delay_ctrl (
    input clk,
    input reset,

    input faster,
    input slower,
    output [3:0] delay,

    input write,
    input [7:0] writedata
);
reg [3:0] delay_intern = 8;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            delay_intern <= 8;
        end else if (write) begin
            delay_intern <= writedata;
        end else if (faster) begin
            if (delay_intern > 1) begin
                delay_intern <= delay_intern - 1;
            end
        end else if (slower) begin
            if (delay_intern < 15) begin
                delay_intern <= delay_intern + 1;
            end
        end
    end

    assign delay = delay_intern;
endmodule
